case_evidence.molecule: 2Nap-Ac phosphonate SAM at one registered ITO site
case_evidence.scope: Existing case evidence only; not a new full-chain validation and not a universal count or guarantee.
case_evidence.summary: 20,736 skeleton grid points; 3,655 passed pre-optimization screen; 2,765 passed post-optimization common-phase checks; 121 symmetry-aware representatives; 1,292 of 1,452 site P-C rolls passed; one pose per skeleton selected for MACE; 121 valid surface structures, 81 surface-geometry clusters and 7 Pareto/endpoint candidates.

change: Remove all alternate PVKSAM initial-conformer entry paths, including the scanner legacy 216-start branch. fixed-site-cpu now accepts only the hash-bound output of the selected per-skeleton MMFF94s single-roll selector. Keep the one reviewed phosphonate skeleton-grid route through MACE, growth, H0, global proton placement and cyclic annealing.

engineering_validation.project_front_tests: 79 passed (mace conformation scan and PVKSAM front-contract tests)

limitations: Initial input route is phosphonate-only; carboxylate original-molecule adapter is not connected.
The isolated skeleton scanner infers adjacency from reviewed unoptimized H0 coordinates; compare it to the authoritative source SDF for every new molecule.
The --pvksam-front controller seals H0 intake and executes only the CPU skeleton grid; force-field, deduplication, site roll, MACE and growth remain explicit handoffs.
fixed-site-cpu requires the selected single-roll schema and its hash-bound selector receipt; it does not generate torsions itself.
MMFF94s gas-phase single-point energy selects one MACE start and is not an adsorption-energy ranking.
The cited case covers one molecule and one registered ITO site prototype; it does not prove universal conformer coverage or multi-site growth.
